items.summary: Recommendation: approve the single reversible, validation-gated SEO change for saveusfarms.com; retain all financial-claim gates. The baseline is decision-useful: 1,668 impressions, 0 clicks, position 10.5, and 0% CTR. A 14-day or 100-new-impression learning window is appropriate, with rollback limited to the metadata/content diff. Do not claim revenue, ROI, contribution margin, cost-to-learn, causal lift, forecast, or budget efficiency from this change. Contribution margin is not calculable: Amazon revenue covers only 2026-09-21 ($4.92 aggregate commission; 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items), while AI spend covers 2026-10-01 ($34.69846565 across 223 calls and 20 observed sites versus 38 expected); periods are misaligned, all commission is on aggregate tracking_id other, site-attributed income is $0, AI allocation is incomplete, and infrastructure/domain costs and budgets are absent. Cost-to-learn is not calculable until post-change impressions/clicks are observed and matched to the change; minimum measurement is the target page/query GSC impressions, clicks, CTR, position, deployment timestamp, and attributable revenue using a registered tracking ID. Budget exposure is not calculable because monthly spend, fixed-cost, marketing-budget, and revenue-floor fields are blank; this request has no authorized external spend. Retain the implementation gate and do not create duplicate finance telemetry work.
